record.paper_title:
AIM Workshop “Pólya-Schur-Lax Problems: Hyperbolicity and Stability
Preservers” — A List of Open Problems
record.original_question:
Let LP^2 denote the Laguerre-Pólya class of entire functions in two
variables. Determine whether functions in LP^2 admit
Lax-type infinite determinantal representations, for example whether
every function in LP^2 can be realized as a
Weinstein-Aronszajn determinant of a pencil of infinite Hermitian or
positive-definite matrices.

evidence.quote: Problem 16 (Determinantal representations for Laguerre-Pólya functions). Let LP 2 denote the Laguerre-Pólya class of entire functions in two variables (cf., e.g., [55, Chap. IX]; see also [11]).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{LP}^2$ denote the Laguerre–Pólya class of entire functions in two complex variables, that is, the closure (in the topology of locally uniform convergence on $\mathbb{C}^2$) of the set of real two-variable polynomials all of whose complex zeros lie in a prescribed real-stable locus, equivalently entire functions $f(z_1,z_2)$ that are limits of real polynomials $p_n(z_1,z_2)$ such that $p_n(z_1,z_2)\neq 0$ whenever $\mathrm{Im}(z_1)>0$ and $\mathrm{Im}(z_2)>0$ (and the real restriction is non-vanishing for purely real arguments under the appropriate sign convention).

For a pencil of (possibly infinite) Hermitian operators $A_0, A_1, A_2$ on a separable Hilbert space, with $A_0$ trace-class (or otherwise of determinant class) and $A_1, A_2$ self-adjoint, the Weinstein–Aronszajn determinant of the pencil $A_0 + z_1 A_1 + z_2 A_2$ is the regularized infinite determinant $\det(I + K(z_1,z_2))$ obtained after extracting a reference invertible part, yielding an entire function of $(z_1,z_2)$.

Question: Does every function $f \in \mathcal{LP}^2$ admit a Lax-type infinite determinantal representation? More precisely, can every $f \in \mathcal{LP}^2$ be written as the Weinstein–Aronszajn determinant of a pencil $A_0 + z_1 A_1 + z_2 A_2$ where the $A_i$ are infinite Hermitian (or positive-definite) matrices/operators on a separable Hilbert space?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search returns only the original AIM problem list and tangentially related works on the Laguerre–Pólya class and determinantal representations; no published resolution (positive or negative) of infinite Lax-type determinantal representations for the two-variable Laguerre–Pólya class was found. The problem appears to remain open.
